title: Run Result Read Contract for Observe Source v1
description: Layout rule v2: walk .fgos/assignments lexically to depth 16. A runs directory marks its parent as an assignment; its relative assignment id may contain /. Read only direct runs/<attempt>/result.json children, never descend into attempts or follow symlinks. assignment.json is optional, with absent/unreadable/symlink metadata yielding null role and adapter. Inline unit records with unitRunId but no runId are skipped as inline-record. Coverage counts unparseable, no-run-id, no-timestamp, symlink, duplicate-run-id and depth skips; traversal barriers count one skipped candidate, preserving observed + skipped = runDirsSeen.

result.description: Fields read from result.json. Observed records require a nonempty runId and a nonempty settledAt or timestamp string. Lexical traversal retains the first valid record for a duplicate runId. Missing/unparseable result files are skipped, including unsettled attempts.

runId.description: Identifier of the run, used as subject id.

settledAt.description: Timestamp of settlement, primary timestamp for the observation.

timestamp.description: Fallback timestamp if settledAt is missing.

assignmentId.description: Historical record field; the observation assignmentId is the assignment directory's relative path beneath assignments and may contain /.

assignment.description: Optional assignment.json metadata read once per assignment; never follows a symlink. It is not required to observe a run.
